instruction: A curled-forward pangolin standing on all fours, its body armored in overlapping keratin scales that fan from a narrow snout down a long tapering tail. Scale plates are warm olive-brown with amber edge highlights and fine wear scratches, while the soft belly and stubby clawed forelimbs show pinkish-grey wrinkled skin. Tiny black eyes and a slitted nostril tip finish the head.
